title: AD 3 · «أنا الخيط اللي تقطع» (victim, inside the skin) (re-rolls)

shots.h3_prompt: Her thin middle simply springs apart into a top half and a bottom half that dangle, her one head stays the same, and she keeps talking in shock until the very end. The threads sway and stretch side to side like elastic bands, still holding hands. The center thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while she is pulled thinner, her halves spring apart with a small spark and she wobbles in shock. The others gasp and keep bouncing nervously toward her. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.rr_why: The snap goes wrong: at 2.45-2.6 s the thin middle balloons into a glowing ring, the centre thread's head smears into a blur in a light burst, and she re-forms as TWO full characters joined in a V (a second head = a copy of the character, 6 threads instead of 5); the view also jumps about 15% closer. 0-2.4 s is clean (stretching, gasp, mouth moves) but too short for 3.42 s of VO.
